'''Undead Witch''' is a monster found in [[The Shadow Reef]]. They use powerful magic attacks dealing damage equal to roughly 20% of the target's maximum health, though the attack has significant delay and deals damage after the projectile disappears, even if the witch is killed.

As undead, they are susceptible to the effects of the [[salve amulet]] and its [[salve amulet (e)|enhanced version]], the [[Undead Slayer]] perk and effects of the [[Undead Slayer (ability)|Undead Slayer]] [[ability]].

* Floor 3: {{NoCoins|{{#expr:{{#var:avg_drop_val}}+{{Average drop value|mob=Undead Witch#Normal mode (Floor 3)|raw=y}}}}}} coins.
